policies.scope: unchanged: the adapter acts on select_chain with the latest chain link player = opponent (own turn included); no card-id gate added

hands.note: the two existing BV1 hands (not a new-hand test)

names: 無垢なる者 メディウス

scripts.c49036338.lua: none (PSY-Frame Driver is a Normal Monster, type 17)

script_reading.gamma: SpecialSummonStep(Driver) + SpecialSummonStep(Gamma) + one SpecialSummonComplete, then NegateActivation and destroy
script_reading.g: during chain resolution each EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS registers one flag; at EVENT_CHAIN_SOLVED it draws the flag count; the actual draw count is measured, not assumed
script_reading.ash: negates an effect that searches / special summons / sends from the deck; no special summon

own_side: the compared policy decides from the start of turn 1; nothing forced (no Graphrea branch control)
target: the opponent's first chance to respond to OUR first Medius① (code 97556336, description Stringid(id,0)) when that Medius① is chain link 1; identified by card / effect / activating player / public chain, never by a step number; if our first Medius① is not chain link 1, or the specified opponent effect is illegal, the condition is recorded as not established (no other hand is searched)
opponent: passes until the target; at the target activates Ash (ASH) or Gamma (GAMMA); for Gamma chooses Driver, face-up attack position (else the first option), the first zone; no other optional effect afterwards; first legal option only if the pass policy cannot decide (logged)
stop: the first decision after the target chain fully resolved (chain size 0 after the opponent activation), or game over from env.step, or 600 decisions

controls.rule: H1 only: base policy before the target; at OUR first response after the opponent activation exactly one substitution (G activation 23434538 / pass); illegal -> not established, the run stops; afterwards every optional own activation is declined (legal Cancel), forced choices are the base policy's; same stop rule
controls.reuse: a control is not run if an existing comparison record executes exactly the actions the control rule implies from the start to the stop (pre-target path, the substitution, every later own decision, the same stop); checked offline before any control run; reused controls are not counted as runs

record: own public board / hand / chain and the opponent card + effect at each gated screen
legal options, frozen logits, adapter delta, final logits, first choice and pass probability before / after
relative_delta(action) = delta(action) - delta(pass); new_margin = old_margin + relative_delta (cards with the same meaning separated by card / effect / controller / zone)
effects used, resolution, G use and measured draws, hand / deck / field, Medius / Gamma / Driver state
first point where BASE and CAND differ, adapter activations
NPZ, action list, replay check, the 3 hashes, the opponent script log

engine.plan: comparison 8 x (record + replay) = 16; controls up to 4 x 2 = 8; total at most 24; 2 spare only for a harness fix

not_done: the known 8 conditions or the 13 retention cases
